houseparentSignatureBox.$comment: The blank band above the page-8 "Houseparent" rule. Measured against the template: the underscore run is 90.24pt wide at x 72.02 with its ink at y 770.57-772.5, and the line above the block ("The Rehabilitation Team together with the resident:") has its descenders at y 811.40. The box fills 786-806, which clears the printed name below it by ~3pt and that heading by ~5pt. Shared so the on-screen overlay, the browser export and the backend PDF writer stamp the signature in the same place.

houseparentNamePos.$comment: The Houseparent's printed name. It goes BELOW the signature and directly above the rule, so the rule reads as the underline of the name: signature, name, rule, then the form's own "Houseparent" caption. Baseline y 777 puts the 8pt ascenders at 782.7 (clear of the 786 box bottom) and the descenders at 775.3 (clear of the rule's ink at 772.5).

adminOfficerSignatureBox.$comment: The blank band above the page-8 first row's MIDDLE rule, captioned "Administrative Officer". Same row and same baselines as the Houseparent's line: the underscore run is 95.03pt wide at x 223.75 with its ink at y 770.57-772.5, and the caption sits at y 752.11.

adminOfficerNamePos.$comment: The Administrative Officer's printed name, below their signature and directly above their rule - the same shape as the Houseparent's line. Baseline y 777.

swo1SignatureBox.$comment: The blank band above the page-8 first row's RIGHT rule, captioned "SWO I/Case Manager". That rule is printed as three underscore runs (x 346.2 w 65.04, x 411.26 w 30, x 441.29 w 20.16), so the line spans x 346.2 to 461.45 - 115.25pt.

swo1NamePos.$comment: The SWO I/Case Manager's printed name, below their signature and directly above their rule. Baseline y 777.

swo2SignatureBox.$comment: The blank band above the page-8 second row's LEFT rule, captioned SWO II/Center Head. This row is laid out differently from the first: the rules have their ink at y 668-670.25 and the printed names sit BELOW them, so the box goes just above the rule. The x and width are the template's own printed name extent (MARICOR C. NAVARRO, RSW, MSSW, spanning x 72.02 to 251.34) and not the rule's, because the signature is centred over the printed name - see nameInkWidth in triReportPdf.js.

swo3SignatureBox.$comment: The blank band above the page-8 second row's RIGHT rule, captioned SWO III/Section Chief. Same row and baselines as the SWO II line. x and width are the template's printed name extent (NICOLAS Q. REGALARIO, RSW, MSSW, spanning x 329.88 to 518.0), not the rule's.

designatedPersonnel.$comment: The four officials the facility named for the TRI's "Assessed by" block, in the same one-copy-of-the-facts spirit as the coordinates above: the backend PDF writer and the browser print view both read this, so a name can never differ between the published copy and the printed one. The Houseparent's line is not here because it is not fixed - it is whoever prepared and signed the report. adminofficer and swo1 are printed by the app on the first row, which the template leaves blank; swo2 and swo3 are already printed correctly by the template itself on the second row, so the app draws no name for those two and only stamps a signature. 'nameInkWidth' is the template's own measured extent, used to centre each signature over the name it belongs to.
